established_rule: Tuesday PMO-only internal meeting; weekly client report from PMO/PM; monthly executive report. External stakeholders receive monthly reporting only where required.
boundary: Meeting hour, weekly day and timezone are not supplied. Cadence is known and must not be re-asked.

established_rule: Delivery-impact blockers escalate immediately. Internal issues escalate to PMO or CTO at24h based on severity and CTO at48h if unresolved. Client-dependent issues escalate within24h; PMO Lead/Head approval precedes client escalation/de-escalation.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 §5.6 p.9
boundary: Clock anchors, pause and calendar interpretation require configuration; do not replace known windows with invented thresholds.

established_rule: Emergency log within24h; mandatory post-implementation review; Product and Engineering Lead retrospective approval within1–2workingdays. Incident Lead+Engineering Lead authorize emergency implementation, with CTO for P1.
boundary: General GLPI-before-production requirement still exists; no inferred emergency waiver. Exact working-day selection/calendar unresolved.

established_rule: Log engagement and assign PM in Initiation; formal project ID is assigned in Planning.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 Phase1 step1 p.2; Phase2 step1 p.4
boundary: Signed baseline handoff must support engagement identity before a Planning project ID exists.

established_rule: Share signed SOW milestones and costing with Finance; share aligned Planning milestones; PM notifies Finance when milestones are reached and records completion/notification; closure confirms all milestones notified.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 Phase1 step7 p.3; Phase2 step9 p.5; Phase3 step10 p.7; Phase4 steps5–6/exit p.8
boundary: Notification is not recognition, invoice generation or payment. Do not add paid-invoice closure requirement.
current_interpretation: Read with U01-U06. Original claim preserved as historical evidence; latest explicit user clarification controls affected sequence and PMO/Finance responsibility only.

established_rule: All costing follows PM→Head of PMO→CEO; cost-changing revisions repeat that chain.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 Phase1 step5 p.3; §7 p.11; §8 p.11
boundary: This ordered chain is not a universal order for all multi-party approvals.

established_rule: PMO Lead and Engineering Lead review RFP response before commercial sign-off/submission.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 §6.4 p.10
boundary: Keep technical/internal review distinct from commercial costing and external document review.

established_rule: Client signs SOW and PRD before Planning; Product Owner approves scope, Engineering Lead approves estimates; PMO Lead approves the plan for Planning exit.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 Phase1 step7 p.3; Phase2 steps8–9 pp.4–5
boundary: Signed-SOW timing versus Planning-as-SOW-basis wording requires reconciliation if later estimates change baseline.
current_interpretation: Read with U01-U06. Original claim preserved as historical evidence; latest explicit user clarification controls affected sequence and PMO/Finance responsibility only.

established_rule: QA Lead exit with no critical defects precedes Product UAT; Product Manager, Product Owner and client contact approve UAT before deployment.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 Phase3 steps3/5 p.6
boundary: No extra sequential order among UAT roles is stated.

established_rule: Engineering Go/No-Go precedes PM GLPI request; Security, CTO and CEO approve before Infrastructure/DevOps releases. PM+Client post-release go-live records business acceptance.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 Phase3 steps6–8 p.6
boundary: External prerequisite evidence does not confer deployment authority on PMO or agents; no extra duplicated business-acceptance chain.

established_rule: Operational handover needs no extra approval; Head of PMO approves closure; respond to every RFP without a bid/no-bid approval; QA+PM close issues by updating the log; PM classifies changes without approval.
boundary: Do not manufacture approvals through generic manual-handoff contracts.

established_rule: Change approval: Product+Engineering; Client when client-facing; costing chain when cost changes; Engineering Lead+Security Manager timeline agreement; GLPI before deployment.
boundary: Standard changes are described as pre-approved but the approved catalogue and which gates it satisfies are absent.

established_rule: Documents have owner/version and consistent H1/H2/H3 structure. Client documents include executive summary and Scope, Timeline, Risks, Dependencies, Status. PMO Lead reviews every external share. No unresolved comments/placeholders or internal logs/commentary. External issue summaries expose relevant impact/status/resolution only.
boundary: Actual templates and destination permissions remain required. Source requirement for Timeline section does not authorize replanning project deadlines in this amendment.

established_rule: Formal minutes record purpose, decisions, actions, owners, deadlines and scope/timeline changes, and are stored in PMO repository.
source: PMO SOP v1.1 §5.5 p.9
boundary: This is required record content, not authorization for new scope changes.

established_rule: Issue log has unique ID/title/type/severity set by PM/date/project/owner, Open/In Progress/Resolved/Closed states, timestamped notes, owner and next action, documented fix and no duplicate tracker. Security owns risk register; Engineering owns incident lifecycle.
boundary: Generic case patches must not become writes to Security/Engineering masters.

established_rule: Track expiry and remind a general mailbox for team renewal follow-up. Older agreements are described as auto-renewing; newer bank SLAs add expiry tracking.
source: BAAS:document:P0040 14:07
boundary: Few days or maybe a month is suggested lead-time, not approved policy. Exact mailbox/address and agreement clauses still needed.

established_rule: Measure first response/resolution; surface onboarding stage ageing and documentation backlog.
boundary: 30/50-minute comparisons are illustrative, not SLAs. Stage catalogue and thresholds absent.

established_rule: Data supplies client names/usage, Finance adds prices/calculates, recent Power Automate work reduces one-by-one invoicing. Planned BaaS report should include stored correct prices; Finance does not need duplicate pricing platform if report contains them.
boundary: Actual flow/input schema/deployed effects unverified. Generation/posting/sending are distinct effects, not three proven approval gates.

established_rule: QuickBooks individual postings→exported TB→Excel lookup alignment→notes→statements/schedules. Budget imported manually for monthly reporting. Manual income detail can be a breakdown, not additive revenue.
boundary: Native layouts, lookup formula and missing-match behavior, full account maps and numerical oracles not supplied.

established_rule: Two payroll inputs feed working sheet linked to HR staff/BU data. Finance must not edit HR source. BU totals filtered/transferred. Other-staff pooled costs use headcount; shared-service, individual executive ratios and OPEX allocations are separate.
boundary: Illustrative counts are not production ratios. Private allocation workbook deliberately withheld; actual source meanings/keys and formulas remain needed.

boundary: Do not ask whether these methods exist. Exact applicability/calendar, names of new categories and historical treatment remain absent.
